test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_text_index_analysis_pfor ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx_s (s) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha', posting_list_codec = 'pfor') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, text_index_posting_list_block_size = 1048576

CREATE TABLE t_text_index_analysis_bitpacking ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx_s (s) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha', posting_list_codec = 'bitpacking') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, text_index_posting_list_block_size = 1048576

CREATE TABLE t_text_index_analysis_none ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx_s (s) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha', posting_list_codec = 'none') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, text_index_posting_list_block_size = 1048576
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_text_index_analysis_pfor SELECT number, concat('common ', 'medium' || intDiv(number, 1000), ' rare' || number, ' bucket' || (number % 100)) FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO t_text_index_analysis_bitpacking SELECT * FROM t_text_index_analysis_pfor
